Current WFS capabilities list layers titled for Stura di Lanzo flood 2000, including flood areas, deposits, active channel, erosion, landslides and damage. The old saved base URL has no WFS request parameters and returns 404. The capabilities route works and has matching layer titles, but no GetFeature request was made.

description: STURA DI LANZO Alluvione 13-16/10/2000 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by archivio.cittametropolitana.torino.it. The data are taken from the study promoted by the Province of Turin in the context of the "Research program in the field of maintenance and restoration of riverbeds, as well as in the field of hydrogeological protection and soil protection".The dataset represents the critical issues associated with the full occurred along the shaft of ... Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "STURA DI LANZO Flood 13-16/10/2000" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, Italia, Piemonte, Città metropolitana di Torino, dissesto, alluvione. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
